log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 5 gate (packet )

body.p: For the owner. Four gate boxes wait for the full runs and fuzzing on the owner's machine (); the review's runs met every number, and schema validation works.

item.p: Confirming runs (): on the owner's machine, tools/check-main.sh (with the full lint, cut off here), the four suites (tools/run-qt4.sh XP40 and XQ40, run-xslt.sh, run-xsd.sh, then tools/conformance-report.py) and tools/fuzz.sh --seconds 300, which now includes schema_fuzz; then tick the four boxes.
0.2.0 and Phases 3 to 5. 0.2.0 is still untagged; CHANGELOG.md lists XQuery, XSLT and XSD under "Unreleased". Tag 0.2.0 at the Phase 2 commit, or fold them into one release.

WebAssembly budgets (Proposed, four items): sxml.wasm is 1,997,773 bytes stripped and 695,343 gzipped against 2,000,000 / 700,000 (0.1 % and 0.7 % left: the next feature in the JavaScript package breaks it); the CLI with XSD is 4,950,289 / 1,154,545 against 's 5,500,000 / 1,250,000. compileQuery(), XSLT and schemas are still not in the JavaScript package. Confirm the budgets, or ask for optional modules.
XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default (Proposed, ): no (write the declaration, as QT4 expects) or keep yes.

Accepted designs for later sweeps (, ; out of Proposed): match="$var" membership by a node index; IR modules that carry their stylesheet module's URI, for errors in included modules; exporting the package-version match from xslt.h; the XSLT functions in the run-time function table; globals computed on first read (XTDE3052).

Not done in Phase 5 ( to ): is-id of union and list elements; XSLT's ID/IDREF for elements, schema roles, typed modes' schema-element() names, xs:untypedAtomic as a type, xml:lang declarations; the remaining XSD failures (XSD 1.0 rules 1.1 changed, NOTATION union members, XML 1.1 instances, EDC with wildcards).
Performance (): about 4 million evaluation steps a second (release) and no index for $seq[f(.) = $key]; QT4's itunes takes 72 s. A general evaluator item, not a schema one.
Phase 6 and 7 plans (): no docs/tasks/phase-6.md or phase-7.md yet; the next phase is the owner's choice.
CI (): still local only; macOS, Windows and MSVC unbuilt.
